desc:
A W-Engine improved upon the first three generations of the "Lunar" series, offering advantages in output power, noise reduction, and energy capacity.
Unfortunately, each individual metric is slightly weaker than its predecessors, making it a precisely balanced "jack-of-all-trades" product that inspires both love and hate.
desc2: Equip to increase Armorer Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: A cost-effective choice for newcomers exploring Hollows.
name: [Lunar] Semiluna
